resources.string: Keep STS Print Bridge open on this screen (or in the background). If you close the app or swipe it away, printing will stop. Leave it running so your computer or other apps can send print jobs to the USB printer.
Connect the USB printer to this device and make sure it is powered on.
When prompted, tap \"Allow\" to grant USB access to the printer.
Do not close this app or remove it from recent apps — keep it open.
Restart the app if you unplugged and reconnected the printer.
Use a supported thermal receipt (ESC/POS) printer connected via USB OTG.
